FN-QNNYJ55-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 263
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/04/2025
House Bill 263 as introduced would reallocate monthly distributions from the Alabama 911
Board to ensure that local 911 districts receive at least 80% of the balance of the total receipts,
after a 1% deduction for administrative expenses of the board. This bill also provides for the
remaining balance of the monthly receipts to be used as follows: 1) reimburse carriers for certain
911 technology upgrades; 2) fund the cost of required training and certification of public safety
telecommunicators; 3) fund the cost of advisory services to local districts; fund a grant program
for districts demonstrating financial hardship; and 4) equally distribute remaining funds to the
local districts.
